dedupe_keys.name: population estimation from mobile network metadata rome milan turin april 2015

description: This dataset gives static and dynamic population density estimates for Rome, Milan and Turin derived from mobile network subscriber presence metadata, released by Ghazaleh Khodabandelou, Vincent Gauthier, Mounim El Yacoubi and Marco Fiore with their article in IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (2018). The underlying data came from the Telecom Italia Big Data Challenge; for each grid cell and hour of April 2015 the files give the estimated number of people, the 2011 ISTAT census population, a land use label and the cell area, with geometry in the EPSG:3003 system. Coverage: three Italian cities, hourly for one month. Format and access: a ZIP archive of about 82 MB on Zenodo; free under the Open Database Licence, with citation of the article requested. Caveats: estimates are model outputs, not counts; the raw operator metadata are not redistributed for legal reasons; one month only. Simulation uses: time-varying population exposure for hazard and emergency response studies, demand inputs for telecom and other networks, and agent-based models of urban mobility. Related records: the Telecom Italia Big Data Challenge data are the source, and cluster and traffic traces describe network demand.
